film_tone: Dark, brooding, fire-lit with moments of cold dawn introspection
pacing: Slow atmospheric discovery → building tension → frantic obsession at climax → quiet, earned resolution
lighting_style: Low-key with fire as primary source, deep shadows with warm rim highlights, cold blue ambient for exterior scenes

character_bibles.name: Ixchel K'awiil
character_bibles.appearance: Young Maya woman with dark hair and piercing green eyes, slender build, and a scar above her left eyebrow
character_bibles.costume: Traditional Maya garments, including a huipil (blouse) and a maxtli (skirt), made from natural fibers such as cotton and silk
signature_items: a small, intricately carved wooden box

character_bibles.name: K'uk'umatz
character_bibles.appearance: Tall, lean Maya man with dark hair and piercing blue eyes, angular features, and a scar above his right eyebrow
character_bibles.costume: Modern, high-tech outfit, including a black leather jacket and pants, with a silver pendant bearing the symbol of the corporation
signature_items: a pair of high-tech, augmented reality glasses

character_bibles.name: Lady Yaxche
character_bibles.appearance: Elderly Maya woman with gray hair and wise, brown eyes, stately build, and a warm smile
character_bibles.costume: Traditional Maya garments, including a huipil (blouse) and a maxtli (skirt), made from natural fibers such as cotton and silk
signature_items: a beautifully crafted, handmade wooden staff
a small, intricately carved stone pendant

character_bibles.name: Dr. John Taylor
character_bibles.appearance: Middle-aged, Caucasian man with brown hair and glasses, slightly overweight, and a kind face

location_descriptions.name: The Pyramid
location_descriptions.description: A massive, ancient pyramid, covered in intricate hieroglyphics and vines, with a grand staircase leading to the top
location_descriptions.lighting: Low-key, with fire as primary source, deep shadows with warm rim highlights

location_descriptions.name: The Hidden Chamber
location_descriptions.description: A small, dimly lit room, with walls adorned with cryptic symbols and murals depicting the destruction of a great city
location_descriptions.lighting: Low-key, with a single, flickering torch as primary source

location_descriptions.name: The Maya Community
location_descriptions.description: A bustling, vibrant marketplace, filled with people of all ages and backgrounds, selling traditional goods and services
location_descriptions.lighting: Natural, with sunlight filtering through the thatched roofs
